display_long_description:
Stop wasting time on typing passwords. Stop reusing them. Stop trying to guess which ones are safe.

NordPass keeps your access smooth and your security tight.

**Log in without friction with autofill**

Save your passwords once. NordPass autofills them across apps and websites, so you don’t have to type the credentials every time.

**Find and fix weak passwords with Password Health**

Most accounts fail because of reused or simple passwords. NordPass scans your vault and shows which ones are weak, reused, or outdated — then helps you replace them with stronger ones.

**Catch leaks early with Data Breach Scanner**

If your email or passwords appear in a breach, you’ll get alerted. You can act early instead of finding out after an account is taken over.

**Keep everything locked with XChaCha20 encryption**

Your data is encrypted before it leaves your device, so no one else — not even NordPass — can access it. NordPass uses XChaCha20 for stronger protection and better performance.

**Secure more than passwords**

Securely store credit cards, personal details, and important notes in one place and share that sensitive data safely when needed.

**Use it anywhere with cross-device sync**

Your vault is synced across devices, so your logins, payment cards, personal data, and secure notes are always available when you need them.

NordPass focuses on what matters: faster access, fewer weak passwords, and early warnings before problems escalate.
